intro.title: Sanjauli, subah
intro.text: Vicky. Unnees saal. Baap ki garage abhi bhi chalti hai, par usse ab peti kholne ka mann nahi karta.

intro.title: Bazaar
intro.text: Yahan sab ek doosre ko naam se jaante hain. Yahi is jagah ki taakat hai, aur yahi uski kamzori.

intro.title: Aur aaj
intro.text: Government College Sanjauli. Pehla din. Iske gate se andar jaane wala har banda wahi nahi rehta jo bahar tha.

acts.title: College ke Din
acts.blurb: Sanjauli ka ek ladka, pehla saal, aur ek union jiska chunav basketball court par hota hai.

acts.title: Sanjauli ki Sadak
acts.blurb: Campus ka naam bahar bhi chalne laga. Bazaar, baudi, aur ek raat jiske baad Vicky wahi nahi raha.

acts.title: Sattaa ki Seedhi
acts.blurb: Jakhoo se Mall aur Mall se Vidhan Sabha. Har seedhi ki apni keemat hai.

missions.title: Pehla Din
missions.brief: Deepika: 'Late ho gaya. Library mein attendance sheet hai, phir canteen — Thakur Sir wahin milenge.'

cards.title: Pehla Din
cards.text: Gate par bheed. Photocopy wale ke saamne teesre saal ke ladke khade hain. Andar jaana hai to unke beech se jaana hai.

objectives.text: Canteen mein Thakur Sir se milo

missions.$comment: Gate wala kaam hata diya gaya: khel ab college ke **andar** shuru hota hai (forecourt par), isliye "gate tak pahuncho" ulta lagta tha. Pehla kaam ab Library hai.

missions.title: Union ka Parcha
missions.brief: Deepika: 'Chunav aa raha hai. Parche campus bhar mein lagane hain — par Sameer ke ladke phaad rahe hain.'

cards.title: Union ka Parcha
cards.text: College union ka chunav sirf college ka mamla nahi hota. Yahan se hi zile ki rajneeti mein naam banta hai.

cards.title: Sameer
cards.text: Teesre saal ka Sameer. Union ko apne baap ki jaageer samajhta hai — aur ab tak kisi ne use galat nahi kaha.

objectives.text: Sameer ke ladko se bach nikalo

missions.title: Court ka Faisla
missions.brief: Thakur Sir: 'Vote court par hoga. Bhaagna mat — jo bhaagta hai, usse yahan koi yaad nahi rakhta.'

cards.title: Court ka Faisla
cards.text: Basketball court. Do sau ladke. Ek taraf Sameer, doosri taraf ek pehle saal ka ladka jiska naam kal tak koi nahi jaanta tha.

objectives.text: Nateeja aane tak court mat chhodo

missions.title: Bazaar ka Hafta
missions.brief: Dukandaar: 'Beta, tu ab union ka aadmi hai. Yahan har hafte koi aata hai paise lene. Bas ek baar keh de ki nahi dena.'

cards.title: Bazaar ka Hafta
cards.text: Union ka badge lagte hi bazaar ke dukandaar naam se bulane lage. Uske saath unki umeedein bhi aa gayi.

objectives.text: Police ke aane se pehle nikal jao

missions.title: Baudi wali
missions.brief: Chhotu: 'Shart lagi thi na? Aadhi raat, purani baudi, akele. Bas ek ghanta ruk ja wahan. Bhaag mat jaana.'

cards.title: Purani Baudi
cards.text: Angrezon ke zamane ki baudi. Din mein aurtein paani bharti hain. Raat ko koi nahi jaata — aur koi ye batata bhi nahi ki kyun.

cards.title: Aadhi Raat
cards.text: Chhotu ne shart lagayi. Sanjauli mein shart haarne se bura kuch nahi. Vicky raat ko wahan chala gaya.

missions.title: IGMC ki Raat
missions.brief: Deepika: 'Chhotu ko maara hai unhone. Gaadi nikaal — IGMC, abhi. Ambulance ka intezaar mat kar.'

cards.title: IGMC ki Raat
cards.text: Indira Gandhi Medical College. Sanjauli se do kilometre neeche. Raat ko wahan tak pahunchne mein saat minute lagte hain — agar koi rok na le.

objectives.text: Gaadi lo aur Chhotu ko uthao

missions.title: Navbahar ka Naka
missions.brief: Sameer: 'Ab tu bhi usi taraf hai jidhar main hoon. Naka laga hai Navbahar pe. Nikal ke dikha.'

cards.title: Navbahar ka Naka
cards.text: Sameer ab dushman nahi raha — jo upar chadhna chahte hain, wo aapas mein zyada der nahi ladte.

objectives.text: Naka lagne se pehle Navbahar nikal jao

missions.title: Jakhoo ka Sauda
missions.brief: Netaji: 'Upar aa jao. Jakhoo pe baat hoti hai, Mall pe sirf tasveer khinchti hai.'

cards.title: Jakhoo ka Sauda
cards.text: Jakhoo, 2455 metre. Poora Shimla neeche. Netaji ne yahin bulaya — jahan se sheher chhota dikhta hai.

cards.title: Netaji
cards.text: Zile ka purana neta. Har das saal mein ek naya ladka dhoondta hai. Ladke badalte rehte hain, wo wahi rehta hai.

missions.title: Mall ka Julus
missions.brief: Netaji: 'Kal Mall pe julus hai. Bheed teri honi chahiye, naam mera. Abhi ke liye.'

cards.title: Mall ka Julus
cards.text: Scandal Point se Ridge tak. Yahan julus nikalna sirf bheed ka kaam nahi — yahan se tasveer chhapti hai.

missions.title: Vidhan Sabha
missions.brief: Netaji: 'Andar seat ek hi hai. Aaj tay hoga ki uspe kaun baithega — main, ya wo ladka jise maine banaya.'

cards.title: Vidhan Sabha
cards.text: Himachal Pradesh Vidhan Sabha, Chaura Maidan. Sanjauli ke gate se yahan tak — paanch saal.

cards.title: Aakhri Seedhi
cards.text: College ke court par jo shuru hua tha, uska aakhri vote yahan padta hai. Vicky ab wo ladka nahi jo gate se andar gaya tha.
